question: On this frozen finite-base PDP panel, how do explicit, certified and partial-trace encodings differ in valid decision completion under identical conflict budgets and a disclosed safety fuse?

claims.text: Every Found result replays and every Refuted result agrees with an independent complete pair-table known answer.
Valid completion counts on the fixed panel may differ between encodings beyond the repeated certified A/A discrepancy; no population or timing conclusion.
Natural-target full ECDLP performance and asymptotic speed are not established.

arms.description: Existing full ordinate membership witness circuit
Validated finite x domain; no redundant ordinate witnesses
Certified finite domain plus necessary x trace on each finite partial sum
Exact duplicate of certified under another arm name

positive.not_applicable_reason: Planted and cancellation instances are embedded in every arm through the same oracle; small-field controls must decide correctly and any wrong answer invalidates the panel. Wide UNKNOWN is retained as capped, not a detector pass.

negative.not_applicable_reason: An independently refuted n5 signed-base control is embedded in every arm, and uniform_scalar_below_order targets in the stated generated subgroup are common to all arms. This is a paired encoding comparison, not a claim of unusual target structure.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: One native executable and actual production arithmetic/SAT modules; code and binary hashes pinned before affected data.

factors.name: instances
factors.how: 33 exact cases serialized in workload.json from the fixed native seed rule; same points for every arm.

factors.name: order
factors.how: For case index i and replicate r, rotate four arms by i+r; all rows retained.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Single-threaded native solver; one CPU allocation and2GiB process address-space ceiling for the proposed local exception.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Shared development environment recorded; no timing metric. A750ms safety fuse can censor rows, assessed with A/A; no isolation claim.

factors.name: cache_and_layout
factors.how: Fresh Solver per call; field-table caches shared and arm order interleaved. No warmup discarded.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: No retry; flushed JSONL prefix retained. Global600-second guard; unattempted rows reported separately.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Compiled deterministic summary is hashed before affected data, with no adaptive sample selection or population inference.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Deterministic rotation i+replicate avoids putting one arm first throughout.

seed_derivation.note: Native prepare(): seed=202611090000+100*n+10*d+kind_index; StdRng pinned by Cargo.lock. Uniform targets use gen_biguint_below(order), not a truncated u64 scalar. Negative-control seed20261109.

instance_sampling.rule: n7/9/83/131 by d4/5, each with planted/cancellation/two uniform targets, plus one independently refuted n5 control. Inputs fixed before solver data.

blinding.how: Descriptive finite panel only; deterministic Rust summary and decision rules frozen before affected data, arm labels retained for reproducibility. No adaptive interpretation or population test.

power.note: Exact descriptive tabulation of the complete fixed panel; no population significance or power claim. Repeated rows are paired repeats, not independent targets. Both contrasts are reported simultaneously as exact finite-panel tables; no p-values or population rejections are performed.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Pending authorized runtime preflight; no candidate experiment run yet.

primary.name: Valid decided oracle query
primary.definition: One for Found with original-group replay or Refuted matching independent truth; zero for Inconclusive; wrong answers invalidate. Includes the complete oracle call, but counts neither setup field operations nor time.

secondary.name: SAT conflicts
secondary.definition: Cumulative solver conflicts over attempted identity patterns; capped rows remain censored, never imputed as completed.

secondary.name: Peak SAT variables
secondary.definition: Maximum allocated SAT variables in the query; a circuit-size count, not a runtime proxy.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed33 cases by4 arms by2 replicates=264 planned affected-data rows. Runtime preflight is separate and retained.
Stop on any invalid Found/Refuted result, preserving all rows.
Global600-second guard,2000 conflicts and750ms safety fuse per oracle query;2GiB process ceiling; no retries.

decision_rule.text: Report exact per-arm and per-stratum decided/outcome counts and paired differences for this fixed panel only. State any certified A/A disagreements. A difference within its completion discrepancy carries no preference. No speed/scaling inference; disclose every cap and incomplete row.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact valid completion counts and paired outcome table
decision_rule.interval: Range over the two paired repeats plus certified A/A discrepancies; no population confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Difference in valid decided queries on the identical finite panel

inadmissible: No natural ECC2K-130 recovery, end-to-end gain, isolated timing or scaling claim.
Do not treat UNKNOWN as UNSAT, discard timeouts, choose seeds after looking, change the frozen panel or compare unpaired subsets as causal.
Do not launch until execution exception or EKS/checkpoint access is actually available.

literature.claim: Linear trace equations may assist solving; first fall degree is not solving degree.
Existing encoding/basis effects and measured limits; no novelty or scale claim.
Prior certified-domain and restricted-q implementation, explicit UNKNOWN controls and exact scope.

extensions.authorization: pending; default EKS and S3 requirements remain in force until explicit user exception
extensions.preflight: 16 separate engineering calls, one per arm/n; target3*base[0], no primary comparison inference; all rows must be independently valid and n7/9 all arms must return Found with original-group replay, otherwise stop before primary rows. Complete before freezing final runtime metadata. The600-second outer cap includes pilot, freeze preparation and primary execution.
